method: Two independent screenshot review groups, plus main-agent browser checks. Subjective internal rubric; not external certification or owner acceptance.

pages.label: Home
pages.remainingDeductions: Remaining minor costs are compact supplementary text, repeated employee-benefits information and a long mobile sequence. Interaction/a11y scores retain headroom because reviewer did not personally test assistive technology or alternate browsers.

pages.label: Insurance solutions
pages.remainingDeductions: Large service images make mobile route selection a fairly long scan, and corporate-card title wraps over three lines. Generic closing invitation is less specific than page choices. No clipping or ambiguous card affordance observed.

pages.label: BenefitsCare
pages.remainingDeductions: Three stacked mobile plan cards require sequential comparison, and the selection button is partly redundant alongside direct per-plan enquiry buttons. Qualifications remain relatively dense. None blocks comprehension or plan selection.

pages.label: Corporate employee benefits
pages.remainingDeductions: Mobile hero has a three-line audience statement and separated secondary CTA, still legible. Explorer footnote is compact. Audience explorer and yearly-cycle content overlap slightly, but overall sequence remains clear.

pages.label: Business insurance
pages.remainingDeductions: 390px two-column change-trigger cards have narrow body-copy measure. Explorer CTA retains only business intent rather than named risk subtype. These are minor efficiency/finish opportunities, not material blockers.

pages.label: Personal insurance
pages.remainingDeductions: Selected Motor/Travel/Home context is not preserved beyond generic personal enquiry intent. Other-products prompt relies on adjacent/general contact actions. Composition and responsive family-image treatment are substantially improved.

pages.label: About
pages.remainingDeductions: Large desktop date badge still takes substantial attention relative to the broker-service explanation; minor hierarchy preference only.

pages.label: Claims support
pages.remainingDeductions: Introductory reporting instructions repeat step 01. Shorten either passage if refining copy.

pages.label: Guides
pages.remainingDeductions: Headline and introductory sentence repeat insurance review; the illustrative checklist remains tall on mobile, but no longer obstructs the action.

pages.label: Insurance review checklist
pages.remainingDeductions: Mobile section navigation and metadata are small relative to checklist text. This is a minor typography refinement.

pages.label: Contact
pages.remainingDeductions: Sensitive-data helper text remains small. Prior source inspection found email autocomplete on an Email or phone field; not re-tested in this screenshot review.

pages.label: Privacy & security
pages.remainingDeductions: Slightly generous spacing around the introduction; only a minor density preference. No material defect.
Large 404 numeral receives more emphasis than recovery; both primary options remain readily available.

limitations: Desktop Chrome automation and screenshot inspection
No Safari/Firefox, real-device or assistive-technology testing
No deployment or field SEO/performance measurement
status: historical - superseded by owner screenshot feedback and brand/content correction
